sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive sectors dominate performance and stability, led by Consumer Defensive and Healthcare, while Technology and cyclical groups lag in momentum.

Defensive leadership remains firmly entrenched, with only 2 of 11 sectors exhibiting all-green performance across all timeframes. Consumer Defensive sits in the top tier across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, supported by solid follow-through in Healthcare. Meanwhile, Energy holds the top YTD rank despite a more muted momentum profile.

Rotation remains selective and narrow. Basic Materials is the sole group demonstrating positive short-term movement, climbing two positions over the past five sessions. In contrast, Technology and Communication Services are fading at the bottom of the momentum rankings, and slight rank deteriorations in Financials and Utilities highlight an absence of broad-based risk appetite.

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors—Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.92) and Healthcare (momentum 0.83)—remain positive across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD frames.
- **Sustained leadership:** Consumer Defensive is the sole sector maintaining sustained strength, holding a top-3 rank across the 1-, 3-, and 6-month evaluation periods.
- **Top momentum scores:** Consumer Defensive (0.917) and Healthcare (0.833) lead the broader market in overall momentum.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Basic Materials advancing:** Basic Materials improved its 5-session position by +2 spots to reach rank 7, carrying a 0.417 momentum score.
- **Financials and Utilities slipping:** Financials dropped -1 spot to rank 8 (momentum 0.500), while Utilities fell -1 spot to rank 9 (momentum 0.417).
- **Persistent laggards:** Communication Services anchors the bottom of the board at rank 11 with the market's lowest momentum score of 0.167, followed by Industrials at 0.350 (rank 6).

## Divergences
- **Technology disconnect:** Technology holds a solid rank 4 YTD standing, yet suffers from a severely compressed momentum score of 0.250, signaling an underlying loss of trend strength.
- **Energy rank vs. momentum gap:** Energy maintains the #1 YTD rank, but its middling momentum reading of 0.567 trails top performers Consumer Defensive (0.917) and Healthcare (0.833).
- **Consumer Cyclical positioning:** Despite a neutral momentum reading of 0.500, Consumer Cyclical remains depressed near the bottom of the pack at rank 10 YTD.

rotation_phase.label: Defensive
rotation_phase.reasoning: Consumer Defensive and Healthcare are leading as the only all-green groups with top momentum scores, indicating classic risk-off leadership while cyclicals lag.

Fresh momentum is evidenced by 20-session RS new highs in Basic Materials, Consumer Cyclical, Industrials, and Real Estate, alongside positive RS crosses vs SPY in Basic Materials and Communication Services.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and housing-linked consumer groups are surging to the top of performance tables, while technology hardware and clean energy see broad-based deterioration.

Broad market breadth shows 42 of 144 groups holding all-green status, led by consumer staples, healthcare, and insurance. Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (+20 spots to rank 25, momentum 0.91) and Discount Stores (momentum 0.88) headline this sustained strength, alongside sharp weekly rebounds across Residential Construction (+17 spots) and Home Improvement Retail (+14 spots). 

Conversely, tech hardware and growth proxies are fading fast. Semiconductors (-16 spots to rank 75, momentum 0.20), Electronic Components (-20 spots to rank 72, momentum 0.22), and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (-12 spots to rank 26) suffered steep 5-day declines, joining Solar (0.038) and Uranium (0.115) at the bottom of momentum rankings.

## Strength
- **Broad Resilience:** 42 of 144 groups maintain all-green profiles, with sustained top-36 performance over 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons in Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances, Discount Stores, Insurance - Reinsurance, Medical Distribution, and Utilities - Regulated Water.
- **Top Momentum Leaders:** Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.908), Discount Stores (0.881), Insurance - Reinsurance (0.841), Medical Distribution (0.815), and Utilities - Regulated Water (0.815) lead all groups.
- **Healthcare & Consumer Alignment:** Strong momentum persists across Drug Manufacturers - General (0.81), Medical Care Facilities (0.80), and Insurance Brokers (0.78).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Housing & Discretionary Rebound:** Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances led 5-day gains (+20 spots to rank 25), with strong pushes from Packaging & Containers (+17 to rank 62), Residential Construction (+17 to rank 86), and Department Stores (+16 to rank 66).
- **Tech Hardware Stumble:** Electronic Components dropped 20 spots to rank 72 (momentum 0.22), Semiconductors dropped 16 spots to rank 75 (momentum 0.20), and Software - Infrastructure fell 12 spots to rank 81 (momentum 0.34).
- **Severe Momentum Laggards:** Solar anchors the bottom with a 0.038 momentum score (rank 143), alongside Utilities - Independent Power Producers (0.103, rank 139) and Uranium (0.115, rank 141).

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** High-momentum groups showing 5-day rank slip include Specialty Retail (-9 spots, momentum 0.60), Insurance - Diversified (-6 spots, momentum 0.71), and Medical Distribution (-3 spots despite a strong 0.81 momentum).
- **Emerging Materials:** Metals are demonstrating early-stage accumulation despite subdued momentum, led by rank gains in Gold (+12 spots, momentum 0.40), Silver (+8 spots, momentum 0.34), and Copper (+7 spots, momentum 0.35).
- **Industrial Uptick:** Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery improved 10 spots over the last 5 sessions, though its broader momentum score remains lagging at 0.40.
